description: This file defines the StreamAck class, a Java class used for acknowledgment messages in streaming operations. It includes the class's fields, methods for creating success or failure acknowledgments, serialization to JSON, deserialization from JSON, and an enum for status types.

classes.name: StreamAck
classes.description: Immutable class representing acknowledgment messages for streaming, including element ID and status, with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: StreamAck.Status
classes.description: Enum defining possible statuses of acknowledgments: SUCCESS, FAILURE, UNKNOWN, with a method to create a status from its string representation.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Creates a StreamAck instance with status SUCCESS for a given element ID.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Creates a StreamAck instance with status FAILURE for a given element ID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Private factory method to create a StreamAck with specified element ID and status.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a StreamAck from a JSON object, extracting element ID and status.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes StreamAck to a JsonValue representation.

methods.name: getElementId
methods.description: Returns the element ID associated with this acknowledgment.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of this acknowledgment.
